items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Do you remember Johnny Lalla? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No I don't remember him either.

ctx.x: Well I knew a Lawrence Vega but uh Vega. Vega. He was no uh he was no musician. He was uh he used to uh take work contract work because I think I'd done some work for him Brickwood. Lawrence Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega.
No it must be a different man. I think this man played with Papa Lane with Jack Lane. Ah. Did you know uh Johnny Lalla played carnet? Do you remember Johnny Lalla? I think he was from downtown.
No I don't remember him either.
